story: How much has been built by now, and whether anyone lives there, is not known.

A June 2025 TechCabal report said the first district was under construction, with $100 million committed to the first phase by the Africa Finance Corporation, and that it uses Nigeria's existing free zone regulations. It named no current residents.

add_sources.t: Inside Itana, Nigeria's first digital free zone, TechCabal, 10 June 2025

It found that Mischief Reef, Second Thomas Shoal and Subi Reef are low-tide elevations. It also said, in paragraph 309 of the award, that low-tide elevations "cannot be appropriated" and "do not form part of the land territory of a State in the legal sense".

add_sources.t: South China Sea Arbitration, Award of 12 July 2016, Permanent Court of Arbitration, paragraphs 309 and 1040
